eva.docs: small pattern request — users keep hitting "fetch is not defined" in sample apps on older Node images. want a simple, copy-paste set of options in quickstart.
harper.sdk: my vote: library should prefer globalThis.fetch when present, but provide an explicit injection API so apps can opt-in a shim instead of monkeypatching. e.g., export setFetchImplementation + hasGlobalFetch.
mike.infra: agree. injection avoids surprising global mutation in server images. recommend documenting node runtimes matrix and undici@^5 for Node <18. also call out Bun header quirk.
sophie.prod: onboarding wants one-liners. Can we give ESM + CJS examples and a tiny troubleshooting table? Keep snippets <=3 lines.
harper.sdk: example snippets I want to land in quickstart: ```js
// ESM (Node <18)
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
```js
// CJS (Node <18)
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
eva.docs: add a tiny global shim for users who want the absolute quickest fix (with bundler caveat): `if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch`
mike.infra: important caveat: undici's stream and abort semantics differ across versions. normalize streams in SDK and warn that retries interacting with streaming bodies and token refresh can be fragile.
harper.sdk: we'll implement a small internal retry wrapper that retries only idempotent methods by default (GET/HEAD), uses AbortController, and exposes hooks so apps can disable retries or add token-refresh behavior. also export a FetchLike typedef: `type FetchLike = (input: RequestInfo|URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>`.
sophie.prod: please add a console quickstart table: Edge (no action), Node >=18 (no action), Node <18 (install shim), Bun (global, header caveat). That should cut down support tickets.
deploy-bot: ci:tests triggered by @harper.sdk  http-client-compat matrix running.
harper.sdk: i'll watch the failures. likely need to normalize undici Response/body shape for older versions. will open PR with: setFetchImplementation, hasGlobalFetch, FetchLike typedef, small retry wrapper, and minimal quickstart snippets.
eva.docs: i'll add the troubleshooting blurb and one-line fixes to quickstart once PR lands. keep language minimal and copy-paste friendly. :thumbsup:
